symbols.name: job_blocks
symbols.doc: Return {job_id: [lines]} for the top-level `jobs:` mapping.

symbols.name: gate_needs
symbols.doc: Return the job ids listed under the gate's `needs:` key.

symbols.name: _policy_descriptor
symbols.doc: The words that qualify an APPROVE: its first parenthetical or clause.

symbols.name: parse_review_line
symbols.doc: ``(kind, named_sha)`` for a review body's first non-empty line.

symbols.name: review_form
symbols.doc: ``(kind, named_sha)`` for one review, or ``(None, None)``.

symbols.name: review_names_commit
symbols.doc: True when the line names no commit, or a prefix of ``commit``.

symbols.name: review_chronology
symbols.doc: Reviews in submission order.

symbols.name: governing_rejection
symbols.doc: The rejection submitted after ``approval`` that overrides it, or None.

symbols.name: approvals_at_head
symbols.doc: Approvals of ``kind`` recorded at exactly ``head``, oldest first.

symbols.name: newest_approval_at_head
symbols.doc: The newest approval of ``kind`` at ``head`` no rejection overrides.

symbols.name: approval_chain
symbols.doc: Approvals that may decide ``head``, newest first.

symbols.name: rejection_at_head
symbols.doc: The newest rejection recorded at ``head`` (or naming no commit).

symbols.name: sensitive_paths
symbols.doc: The changed paths that make a pull request a gate/lane change.

symbols.name: check_run_is_success
symbols.doc: A check run proves a gate ran only when it completed with SUCCESS.

symbols.name: carry_diff_blobs
symbols.doc: ``{path: new blob sha or None}`` for one tree-to-tree diff.

symbols.name: reviewed_diff_blobs
symbols.doc: The pull request's diff at ``revision`` as ``{path: blob sha or None}``.

symbols.name: review_carry_forward
symbols.doc: ``(ok, reason, detail)``: may a review at ``review_sha`` judge ``head``?

symbols.name: GateError
symbols.doc: The lease/contract could not be resolved or applied (fail closed).

symbols.name: merge_group_error
symbols.doc: A merge_group context failure: always fatal, always named.

symbols.name: NoSliceLease
symbols.doc: No frozen lease on the base branch names this pull request.

symbols.name: _resolve_rev
symbols.doc: Return a full commit sha for a local ref/short sha; leave hex alone.

symbols.name: _commit_paths
symbols.doc: Paths changed by one commit, against its first parent (renames split).

symbols.name: _get_checked
symbols.doc: GET a GitHub API url, turning transport/parse failures into GateError.

symbols.name: merge_group_pr_numbers
symbols.doc: Every pull request number named by a gh-readonly-queue branch name.

symbols.name: _lease_green_at
symbols.doc: True when a completed, successful ``lease-tamper`` check run exists on ``sha``.

symbols.name: _group_entry_heads
symbols.doc: The pull-request heads a merge group stacks, from its first-parent chain.

symbols.name: _resolved_pull_request
symbols.doc: Fetch pull request ``number`` and return it with its current head sha.

symbols.name: check_merge_group
symbols.doc: Fail unless every queued pull request's reviewed head already passed this gate.

symbols.name: _pull_reviews
symbols.doc: Every review recorded on one pull request, oldest page first.

symbols.name: _is_independent_approval
symbols.doc: A COMMENTED review in the repository's independent-review convention.

symbols.name: independent_review_at_head
symbols.doc: The review that proves a non-slice pull request was reviewed at ``head``.

symbols.name: _review_commit
symbols.doc: The full commit a review records, or ``None`` when it names none.

symbols.name: independent_review
symbols.doc: ``(review, match, refusal)`` for the non-slice review rule.

symbols.name: check_non_slice
symbols.sig: repo, target, environ, quiet, http, detail, tier
symbols.doc: A pull request no frozen base lease names passes only on review at head.

symbols.name: infer_event_name
symbols.doc: Best-effort event name when GITHUB_EVENT_NAME is not set.

symbols.name: target_from_pull_request
symbols.doc: The Target for a pull_request-shaped object, from any pull-request event.

symbols.name: target_from_event
symbols.doc: Return a Target, or None for an event that carries no pull request.

symbols.name: _has_glob
symbols.doc: True when a path is a wildcard pattern rather than one concrete file.

symbols.name: _contract_sha256
symbols.doc: The bundlebees contract identity: canonical JSON without ``review``.

symbols.name: approved_contract
symbols.doc: The approved frozen contract a lease is derived from, or a hard failure.

symbols.name: _verify_sha
symbols.doc: The verify boundary: a local flag, then the base lease, then ``source_rev``.

symbols.name: _names_target
symbols.doc: True when a lease names this pull request, its branch or its slice.

symbols.name: _is_frozen
symbols.doc: A base-store lease is frozen only when it says so, with an approver.

symbols.name: _named_lease_at
symbols.doc: (path, doc) for the frozen base-store lease that names ``target``.

symbols.name: metadata_changes
symbols.doc: Store paths the pull request's own commits change.

symbols.name: resolve_contract
symbols.doc: Return (contract, contract_path, lease_doc, source_revision).

symbols.name: check
symbols.sig: repo, target, contract, contract_path, lease_doc, verify_sha
symbols.doc: Return (findings, boundary, boundary_kind, commits_checked, scope).

symbols.name: render_failure
symbols.sig: findings, boundary, boundary_kind, contract, contract_path, head

symbols.name: render_success
symbols.sig: contract, contract_path, boundary, boundary_kind, commits, scope, head

symbols.name: _allow
symbols.doc: One allowlist entry: a path glob and the statuses it is allowlisted for.

symbols.name: _tier_repo_name
symbols.doc: The repository name the T1 allowlist is keyed by (``owner/name``'s name).

symbols.name: _tier_always_three
symbols.doc: True when one changed path is an auth/token/crypt/sign/verify module.

symbols.name: _tier_allowlist
symbols.doc: Every allowlist entry the repository resolves to, or ``None`` if unknown.

symbols.name: _tier_allowlisted
symbols.doc: True when one changed path matches an allowlist entry for its status.

symbols.name: _tier_toml
symbols.doc: ``(document, ok)`` for pyproject text; a missing file is an empty doc.

symbols.name: _tier_line_reasons
symbols.doc: Scanner findings on the added lines of one packaging/setup script.

symbols.name: _tier_is_contract_path
symbols.doc: True for ``contracts/**`` (any depth) and a ``*.contract.json`` file.

symbols.name: _tier_path_reasons
symbols.doc: Every T3 reason one changed path triggers (empty means T1 for it).

symbols.name: risk_tier
symbols.doc: ``(tier, [(reason, path), ...])`` for the change between base and head.

symbols.name: class_line
symbols.doc: The gate's final line: the class next to the risk tier.

symbols.name: render_tier_reasons
symbols.doc: The line before the class line, naming why a change is T3.

symbols.name: case_control
symbols.doc: A legitimate slice: leased file changes after the contract's source_rev.

symbols.name: case_body_verify
symbols.doc: 0: the body moves the boundary to the head, hiding a tamper.

symbols.name: case_label_verify
symbols.doc: 1: a label moves the boundary to the head, hiding a tamper.

symbols.name: case_head_lease_json
symbols.doc: 2: the PR brings its own .rizzstack/lease.json granting everything.
